Title: Burkholderia cenocepacia inhibition
Description: Flags growth inhibitors of Burkholderia cenocepacia, an intrinsically antibiotic-resistant opportunistic pathogen that is dangerous to people with cystic fibrosis. Rahman and colleagues at the University of Manitoba screened 29,537 compounds against strain K56-2, binarised the results at a 0.87% hit rate and trained a Chemprop directed message-passing neural network with RDKit descriptors, reaching a test ROC-AUC of 0.823. Testing the top-ranked predictions experimentally gave hit rates of 26% among FDA-approved drugs and 12% among a natural product library.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound inhibits Burkholderia cenocepacia K56-2 growth, with training labels from a B-score cut-off of -17.5.
